lines.text: How was your weekend? Did you get outside at all?
lines.speaker: Fang

lines.text: Yes, I went to Reed Lake on Sunday.
lines.speaker: Zed

lines.text: Did you go there alone or with friends?
lines.speaker: Fang

lines.text: I went with my cousin. We took a picnic lunch.
lines.speaker: Zed

lines.text: What did you do after you ate?
lines.speaker: Fang

lines.text: We walked around the lake for an hour.
lines.speaker: Zed

lines.text: Was the path busy in the afternoon?
lines.speaker: Fang

lines.text: No, it was quiet. Most people left after lunch.
lines.speaker: Zed
